patterns.what_worked: Verifying the concurrently landed fix against the brief instead of rewriting it (one writer per file); booting the real vendored AceDB + shipped defaults for the fixture; driving both twist call sites through the real class handlers; red-first mutation proofs.

patterns.skill_gap: Detect overlapping lane scope before starting: check the central ledger's running rows and target-file mtimes first.
